rust.name: src/store/vault.rs:314:9: replace Vault::bad_item -> String with String::new()
rust.why: A malformed expiry or definition would still return an error, so only a test that checks its diagnostic would catch the missing vault, item, and field context.

rust.name: src/store/vault/item.rs:68:52: replace == with != in token_of
rust.why: Tokens without a pasted field still read as false, so ordinary token round trips could pass while explicitly pasted tokens are misread.

rust.name: src/store/vault.rs:433:37: delete ! in Vault::update_locked
rust.why: Newly written values can still read back correctly even if the edit drops unrelated fields and leaves old managed fields in the template.

rust.name: src/store/vault/item.rs:112:5: replace remove_client with ()
rust.why: Deleting a client can still report success, and replacing a client with another that has a secret can mask the failure to clear an omitted secret.

rust.name: src/store/vault/item.rs:116:5: replace remove_token with ()
rust.why: A token replacement can update the access token while silently retaining old optional fields that the replacement omits.
